listing.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream (tomodachi-native)
listing.summary: Build Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream for Apple silicon from your own version 1.0.0 Switch game. The project reports touring an island and creating Miis on macOS 27. The macOS 26 target is untested, and Mac controller support is unavailable.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own 1.0.0 NSP for title 010051F0207B2000 and prod.keys. Keep the locally prepared v0 modules, RomFS and shaders. Other versions and regions are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build the Mac app with build_mac_app.py. Optional embedding places your game data in Application Support. The keep-data rebuild preserves RomFS. The iOS build requires local signing and separate game content.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports sound and Mii creation on Mac, with input problems in later scenes. An iPad Air M2 running iPadOS 27 has limited startup evidence. The iPhone build has no play report. There is no release package.
